_schema: Per-op optimization-pass ledger. One file per op under op_passes/. Records EVERY optimization pass (before/after), so the final kept version is auditable against the roofline. Ops are AUTHORED IN PARALLEL (independent work items, one node each) and QUEUED for SERIAL one-by-one integration (cosine-gated) into the wall-time ledger. Metrics are ratios (unit-invariant): off_machine_peak = measured/roofline-floor (lower=closer to ceiling); vs_ref = speedup over the torch/donor reference; cos / set-match = correctness.

fields.passes[]: {pass, name, approach, off_machine_peak:{M}, vs_ref:{M}, correctness, kept, commit, note}
fields.best: the kept pass + verdict vs roofline (at-ceiling | surfaced-as-plateaued + residual-gap cause)

parallel_authoring.rule: fan out op authoring across idle nodes (one op per node); each op runs its own author->measure->iterate loop and records passes here. Integration stays SERIAL: dequeue one finished op at a time, cosine-gate, re-run wall-time ledger.
